Scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 别的人：别人，use 别人 for people other than the speaker or main character; 别的 is normally used to distinguish a different item or type. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 2: 别的人：别人，Use “别人” for people other than oneself when no specific comparison group has been introduced. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 3: 别的人：别人，别的人 distinguishes people from a previously mentioned person or group, but no such comparison has been established here; 别人 means other people in general. [teacher rule: bieren]

output.reason: All runs identify 别的人 as the same error and correctly replace it with 别人.
